race.description: Ladbrokes Flex Your Multi Stays Alive Mdn Plate
race.comment: VANTAA (10) was hard in the market on debut at Mornington and ran a strong race over 1500m, beaten just a head in an encouraging effort. He should come on nicely from that and looks very hard to beat, especially with a couple of key dangers coming out. MOLESWORTH (4) resumes for his second campaign. He was about the mark in three runs last time in and Billy Egan draws well. If he's fit enough he'll go close. LATASSA (8) has upside off a solid return at Bendigo and can roll forward, this trip will suit nicely and she's expected to improve. ZVEREV (5) ran well on debut at Seymour and will be better for that, keeping safe.
